checks.name: runner_parses_artifacts
checks.result: Storyboard and video artifacts are parsed fail-closed, including unknown sections, unparseable nodes, interval endpoints, references, transitions, and prohibition-body boundaries.

checks.name: runner_computes_results
checks.result: All seven structural categories are computed independently; Golden cases pass and category-specific mutations fail in their responsible category.

checks.name: tamper_detection
checks.result: The runner rejects public expectation fingerprint tampering, contract/source authority changes, segment/ref rewrites, directing-field drift, terminal/cut topology changes, reference-target errors, and forbidden-text leakage.

repair_summary.authority_binding: Each Golden expectation now binds the exact R1.3 dual-output contract fingerprint and semantic-source hash, and its public fingerprint must equal the independent runner authority.
repair_summary.category_specific_validation: Timing, cuts, reference duties, forbidden routes, homology, and format now reject their own mutations instead of relying only on whole-artifact hashes.
repair_summary.directing_homology: Storyboard and video are compared panel-by-panel for time, phase, shot size, camera motion, description presence, segment identity, references, boundaries, terminal nodes, and transitions.
repair_summary.fail_closed_inputs: Unknown sections, empty required sections, unparseable timeline nodes, invalid intervals, missing seconds, duplicate seconds, and exclusive-end panels are rejected.
